calibration.method: local geometry registration: nine cylinder collision boundaries (SDF) against map occupancy cells; does not use AMCL/robot pose
calibration.uncertainty: resolution 0.05 m; local fit window +/-0.2m, +/-5deg; geometry/template approximations; NOT globally unique without more landmarks

A.validity: simulation ground truth, header.stamp interpolation, static map landmark calibration; one run per condition

B.validity: simulation ground truth, header.stamp interpolation, static map landmark calibration; one run per condition

warning: One instrumented run each. Do not infer EKF superiority. RMSE conditional on landmark registration resolution and AMCL stamp semantics.
